mn122:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
mn122:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya kapilavatthuṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn122:2.2: kapilavatthusmiṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāro, tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
mn122:2.3: tena kho pana samayena kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāre sambahulāni senāsanāni paññattāni honti.
mn122:2.4: addasā kho bhagavā kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāre sambahulāni senāsanāni paññattāni.
mn122:2.6: sambahulāni kho kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāre senāsanāni paññattāni.
mn122:2.7: sambahulā nu kho idha bhikkhū viharantīti.
mn122:2.8: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ ghaṭāya sakkassa vihāre cīvarakammaṃ karoti.
mn122:2.9: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito, yena ghaṭāya sakkassa vihāro tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn122:2.10: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
mn122:2.11: sambahulāni kho ānanda, kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāre senāsanāni paññattāni,
mn122:2.12: sambahulā nu kho ettha bhikkhū viharantīti.
mn122:2.13: sambahulāni bhante, kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāre senāsanāni paññattāni,
mn122:3.1: na kho ānanda, bhikkhu sobhati saṅgaṇikārāmo saṅgaṇikārato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto gaṇārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito.
mn122:3.2: so vatānanda, bhikkhu saṅgaṇikārāmo saṅgaṇikārato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto gaṇārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito, yaṃ taṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhasukhaṃ tassa sukhassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn122:3.3: yo ca kho so ānanda, bhikkhu eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharati. tassetaṃ bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: yaṃ taṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhasukhaṃ tassa sukhassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
mn122:4.1: so vatānanda, bhikkhu saṅgaṇikārāmo saṅgaṇikārato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto gaṇārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito sāmayikaṃ vā kantaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharissati, asāmayikaṃ vā akuppanti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn122:4.2: yo ca kho so ānanda, bhikkhu eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharati, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: sāmayikaṃ vā kantaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharissati, asāmāyikaṃ vā akuppanti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
mn122:5.1: nāhaṃ ānanda, ekarūpampi samanupassāmi: yattha rattassa yatthābhirattassa rūpassa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā na uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassūpāyāsā.
mn122:6.1: ayaṃ kho ānanda, vihāro tathāgatena abhisambuddho, yadidaṃ
mn122:6.2: sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā ajjhattaṃ suññataṃ upasampajja viharituṃ
mn122:6.3: tatra ce ānanda, tathāgataṃ iminā vihārena viharantaṃ bhavanti upasaṅkamitāro bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo rājāno rājamahāmattā titthiyā titthiyasāvakā.
mn122:6.4: tatrānanda, tathāgato vivekaninneneva cittena vivekapoṇena vivekapabbhārena vūpakaṭṭhena nekkhammābhiratena byantībhūtena sabbaso āsavaṭṭhānīyehi dhammehi aññadatthu uyyojanikapaṭisaṃyuttaṃyeva kathaṃ kattā hoti.
mn122:7.2: ajjhattaṃ suññataṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti. tenānanda, bhikkhunā ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapetabbaṃ, sannisādetabbaṃ, ekodi kātabbaṃ, samādahātabbaṃ.
mn122:7.3: kathañca ānanda, bhikkhu ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapeti sannisādeti ekodiṃ karoti samādahati.
mn122:8.1: idhānanda, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ
mn122:8.5: evaṃ kho ānanda, bhikkhu ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapeti, sannisādeti, ekodi karoti, samādahati.
mn122:9.2: tassa ajjhattaṃ suññataṃ manasikaroto suññatāya cittaṃ na pakkhandati, nappasīdati, na santiṭṭhati, na vimuccati.
mn122:9.3: evaṃ santametaṃ ānanda, bhikkhu evaṃ pajānāti:
mn122:9.4: ajjhattaṃ suññataṃ kho me manasikaroto ajjhattaṃ suññatāya cittaṃ na pakkhandati, nappasīdati, na santiṭṭhati, na vimuccatī’ti.
mn122:9.9: tassa āneñjaṃ manasikaroto āneñjāya cittaṃ na pakkhandati, nappasīdati, na santiṭṭhati, na vimuccati.
mn122:9.10: evaṃ santametaṃ ānanda, bhikkhu evaṃ pajānāti:
mn122:9.11: āneñjaṃ kho me manasikaroto āneñjāya cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccatī’ti.
mn122:10.1: tenānanda, bhikkhunā tasmiṃyeva purimasmiṃ samādhinimitte ajjhattaṃ eva cittaṃ saṇṭhapetabbaṃ, sannisādetabbaṃ, ekodikātabbaṃ, samādahātabbaṃ.
mn122:10.3: tassa ajjhattaṃ suññataṃ manasikaroto ajjhattaṃ suññatāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn122:10.4: evaṃ santametaṃ ānanda, bhikkhu evaṃ pajānāti:
mn122:10.5: ajjhattaṃ suññataṃ kho me manasikaroto ajjhattaṃ suññatāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccatīti.
mn122:10.10: tassa āneñjaṃ manasikaroto āneñjāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn122:10.11: evaṃ santametaṃ ānanda, bhikkhu evaṃ pajānāti:
mn122:10.12: āneñjaṃ kho me manasikaroto āneñjāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccatīti.
mn122:11.1: tassa ce ānanda, bhikkhuno iminā vihārena viharato caṅkamāya cittaṃ namati. so caṅkamati
mn122:11.2: evaṃ maṃ caṅkamantaṃ nābhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantīti.
mn122:11.4: tassa ce ānanda, bhikkhuno iminā vihārena viharato ṭhānāya cittaṃ namati. so tiṭṭhati:
mn122:11.5: evaṃ maṃ tiṭṭhantaṃ nābhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantīti.
mn122:11.7: tassa ce ānanda, bhikkhuno iminā vihārena viharato nisajjāya cittaṃ namati. so nisīdati:
mn122:11.8: evaṃ maṃ nisīdantaṃ nābhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantīti.
mn122:11.10: tassa ce ānanda, bhikkhuno iminā vihārena viharato sayanāya cittaṃ namati. so sayati:
mn122:11.11: evaṃ maṃ sayantaṃ nābhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantīti.
mn122:12.1: tassa ce ānanda, bhikkhuno iminā vihārena viharato kathāya cittaṃ namati. so
mn122:12.2: yāyaṃ kathā hīnā gammā pothujjanikā anariyā anatthasaṃhitā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati. seyyathidaṃ: rājakathā corakathā mahāmattakathā senākathā bhayakathā yuddhakathā annakathā pānakathā vatthakathā sayanakathā mālākathā gandhakathā ñātikathā yānakathā gāmakathā nigamakathā nagarakathā janapadakathā itthikathā purisakathā surākathā visikhākathā kumbhaṭṭhānakathā pubbapetakathā nānattakathā lokakkhāyikā samuddakkhāyikā itibhavābhavakathā, iti vā iti evarūpiṃ kathaṃ na kathessāmīti.
mn122:12.4: yā ca kho ayaṃ ānanda, kathā abhisallekhikā cetovinīvaraṇasappāyā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. seyyathidaṃ: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā vīriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā, iti evarūpiṃ kathaṃ kathessāmīti.
mn122:13.1: tassa ce ānanda, bhikkhuno iminā vihārena viharato vitakkāya cittaṃ namati. so
mn122:13.2: ye te vitakkā hīnā gammā pothujjanikā anariyā anatthasaṃhitā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattanti. seyyathidaṃ: kāmavitakko vyāpādavitakko vihiṃsāvitakko, iti evarūpe vitakke na vitakkessāmīti.
mn122:13.4: ye ca kho ime ānanda, vitakkā ariyā niyyānikā niyyanti. takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya. seyyathidaṃ: nekkhammavitakko avyāpādavitakko avihiṃsāvitakko. iti evarūpe vitakke vitakkessāmīti.
mn122:14.3: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
mn122:14.7: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn122:15.1: yattha bhikkhunā abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
mn122:15.2: atthi nu kho me imesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu aññatarasmiṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ vā āyatane uppajjati cetaso samudācāroti.
mn122:15.3: sace ānanda, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ pajānāti:
mn122:15.4: atthi kho me imesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu aññatarasmiṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ vā āyatane uppajjati cetaso samudācāroti.
mn122:15.5: evaṃ santametaṃ ānanda, bhikkhu evaṃ pajānāti:
mn122:15.6: yo kho imesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu chandarāgo, so me appahīnoti.
mn122:15.8: sace panānanda, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ pajānāti.
mn122:15.9: natthi kho me imesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu aññatarasmiṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ vā āyatane uppajjati cetaso samudācāroti,
mn122:15.10: evaṃ santametaṃ ānanda, bhikkhu evaṃ pajānāti:
mn122:15.11: yo kho imesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu chandarāgo, so me pahīnoti.
mn122:16.1: pañca kho ime ānanda, upādānakkhandhā, yattha bhikkhunā udayabbayānupassinā vihātabbaṃ.
mn122:16.2: iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo.
mn122:16.4: iti vedanāya samudayo, iti vedanāya atthaṅgamo. iti saññā …pe…
mn122:16.6: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamoti.
mn122:17.1: tassa imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato, yo pañcasupādānakkhandhesu asmimāno, so pahīyati.
mn122:17.2: evaṃ santametaṃ ānanda, bhikkhu evaṃ pajānāti:
mn122:17.3: yo kho imesu pañcasūpādānakkhandhesu asmimāno, so me pahīnoti.
mn122:18.1: ime kho te ānanda, dhammā ekantakusalāyatikā ariyā lokuttarā anavakkantā pāpimatā.
mn122:19.2: kaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno arahati sāvako satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ api paṇujjamānoti.
mn122:19.3: bhagavammūlakā no bhante, dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata bhante, bhagavantaṃyeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho, bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
mn122:20.1: na kho ānanda, arahati sāvako satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ yadidaṃ suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ tassa hetu
mn122:20.3: dīgharattassa hi vo ānanda, dhammā sutā dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
mn122:20.4: yā ca kho ayaṃ ānanda, kathā abhisallekhikā ceto vinīvaraṇasappāyā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. seyyathidaṃ: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā vīriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā. evarūpiyā kho ānanda, kathāya hetu arahati sāvako satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ api paṇujjamāno.
mn122:21.1: evaṃ sante kho ānanda, ācariyūpaddavo hoti. evaṃ sante antevāsūpaddavo hoti. evaṃ sante brahmacārūpaddavo hoti.
mn122:22.2: idhānanda, ekacco satthā vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn122:22.3: tassa tathā vūpakaṭṭhassa viharato anvāvaṭṭanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
mn122:22.4: so anvāvaṭṭantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu ceva jānapadesu ca mucchati, nikāmayati, gedhaṃ āpajjati, āvaṭṭati bāhullāya.
mn122:22.6: ācariyūpaddavena avadhiṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā,
mn122:23.2: tasseva kho panānanda, satthu sāvako tassa satthu vivekamanubrūhayamāno
mn122:23.3: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn122:23.4: tassa tathā vūpakaṭṭhassa viharato anvāvaṭṭanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
mn122:23.5: yo anvāvaṭṭantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu ceva jānapadesu ca mucchati, nikāmayati, gedhaṃ āpajjati, āvaṭṭati bāhullāya.
mn122:23.7: antevāsūpaddavena avadhiṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
mn122:24.2: idhānanda, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
mn122:24.3: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn122:24.4: tassa tathā vūpakaṭṭhassa viharato anvāvaṭṭanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
mn122:24.5: so anvāvaṭṭantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu ceva jānapadesu ca na mucchati, na nikāmayati, na gedhaṃ āpajjati. na āvaṭṭati bāhullāya.
mn122:24.6: tasseva kho panānanda, satthu sāvako tassa satthu vivekamanubrūhayamāno
mn122:24.7: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn122:24.8: tassa tathā vūpakaṭṭhassa viharato anvāvaṭṭanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
mn122:24.9: so anvāvaṭṭantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu ceva jānapadesu ca mucchati, nikāmayati, gedhaṃ āpajjati. āvaṭṭati bāhullāya.
mn122:24.11: brahmacārūpaddavena avadhiṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
mn122:24.13: tatrānanda, yo cevāyaṃ ācariyūpaddavo yo ca antevāsūpaddavo, ayaṃ tehi brahmacārūpaddavo dukkhavipākataro ceva kaṭukavipākataro ca, api ca vinipātāya saṃvattati.
mn122:25.1: tasmātiha maṃ ānanda, mittavatāya samudācaratha, mā sapattavatāya.
mn122:25.2: taṃ vo bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn122:25.3: kathaṃ cānanda, satthāraṃ sāvakā sapattavatāya samudācaranti no mittavatāya:
mn122:25.4: idhānanda, satthā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti anukampako hitesī anukampaṃ upādāya
mn122:25.5: idaṃ vo hitāya idaṃ vo sukhāyāti.
mn122:25.6: tassa sāvakā na sussūsanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti. vokkamma ca satthusāsanā vattanti.
mn122:25.7: evaṃ kho ānanda, satthāraṃ sāvakā sapattavatāya samudācaranti no mittavatāya.
mn122:26.1: kathañcānanda, satthāraṃ sāvakā mittavatāya samudācaranti no sapattavatāya:
mn122:26.2: idhānanda, satthā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti anukampako hitesī anukampaṃ upādāya:
mn122:26.3: idaṃ vo hitāya idaṃ vo sukhāyāti.
mn122:26.4: tassa sāvakā sussūsanti, sotaṃ odahanti, aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, na ca vokkama satthusāsanā vattanti.
mn122:26.5: evaṃ kho ānanda, satthāraṃ sāvakā mittavatāya samudācaranti, no sapattavatāya.
mn122:26.6: tasmātiha maṃ ānanda, mittavatāya samudācaratha, mā sapattavatāya.
mn122:26.7: taṃ vo bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn122:27.1: na kho ahaṃ ānanda, tathā parakkamissāmi. yathā kumbhakāro āmake āmakamatte.
mn122:27.6: attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
